opening.text: I have pain that came on all of a sudden. It feels tender, stabbing like a knife, and sharp, and I'd rate it a 5 out of 10. The pain gets worse when I breathe in deeply. I'm quite short of breath, it's hard to breathe, and I've been coughing up blood. I've had surgery within the last month, I'm currently taking hormones, and in the last 4 weeks I travelled to North America.
